get_config_finetuning: get the default finetuning learner config with ResNet34, SGD optimizer, and cosine decay schedule
get_test_config_quick: get a lightweight test config with a linear model, one step, and constant learning rate
customize_augmentations: customize train and eval augmentation chains including random crop, flip, and normalization
override_optimizer_kwargs: override the SGD optimizer momentum, nesterov, and weight decay settings in the config
set_finetuning_strategy: set the finetuning strategy to INDEPENDENT for per-task train state initialization
